### Fixed
- **The Overview's `Valkey memory used` stat and `Memory used against the limit` panel divide each Valkey's used memory by its own `maxmemory`** (giantswarm/giantswarm#36711). Both divided the highest usage in a namespace by the highest bound, which can come from different instances: `agent-platform` runs `muster-valkey` next to an unbounded Valkey of another release. The panel draws one line per instance (`job`) instead of one per namespace, the same grouping as `AgentPlatformValkeyMemoryHigh` (giantswarm/prometheus-rules#2183).
